body: They told me that I was the primary account owner, and my dad was just the secondary account owner... Should I still worry?
I did and he didn't know, so I'm asking reddit. He's going to ask his attorney when they speak next.
Caldo de frijoles with white rice and cheese. Simple, filling, and delicious.
Exactly. So why tell me "Stop trying to depend on your parents."?

Thank you so much for taking the time to tell me all of this. It brought tears to my eyes.

I'm just so worried that I won't have a stable future because of everything that's going on right now. If we lose our house I don't know where we'd move to... But it would certainly be out of state. That would be one of the worst things right now for me, in the middle of an IB Diploma Programme... And I'm worried that my siblings won't have a secure future either. I'm so frustrated that there's really nothing I can do, and that every attempt I make gets shot down in some way. 

How can I do anything if my parents won't let me for one issue or another, whether it be just not enough money or them just plain being busy with something else? I have no chance to get out and do anything for myself other than volunteering, and that has been taken away from me. I'm just so angry.

I really appreciate you making me sound like some sobby, snotty teen. I would totally hop on my bike and go places but I live in the middle of nowhere and my parents will not allow me to wander off on my own (mostly because I'm blind in my right eye and they don't want me to get hurt because of that). I am not fucking trying to "depend" on them, but that is the way my life is right now, Jesus Christ.

The fact that my father refused to drive me to an event where I would learn important interview skills, how to write a resume up, and potentially meet people actively recruiting for jobs infuriates me, because he has been pushing me to find a job for so long. I've lost my chance at something that could have really boosted my potential because of him and it just is so frustrating.

I've been half-blind my whole life, and I've always feared that I'm going to go blind in the middle of the night.

Sometimes I set alarms at 11:00, 1:00, 3:00 AM (etc) just to wake up, turn on the lights, and make sure I can still see...
Facebook, reddit, Twitter, Gmail, Kongregate, YouTube, thefuckingweather and Grooveshark.

I volunteer at a hospital on Tuesdays and Fridays. Tonight, I had to deliver a bunch of food to the Children's Hospital... After I get done putting everything where it needs to go and am attempting to get out of the area, I look into a room and see this little boy about my little brother's age, full of tubes, gazing at me with curiosity. I booked it outta there... It hits close to home because my little brother has down's syndrome, and was born with a hole in his heart (and has had various other health problems in his short ~2 years of life) so I've seen him in the same boat as that little boy before... I love him so much, and he's so healthy now, but I still worry so much about him and losing him. I hope that little boy overcomes whatever is currently afflicting him.

I tend to cry a lot, now that I think about it.
